title: RELICFALL · Beneath the Beacon
design: Reference-driven: user lighthouse / keeper / leviathan / descent artworks

biomes.name: Keeper’s Quarters
biomes.description: Unlit brass clocks, oil tins and warped floorboards.

biomes.name: Flooded Maintenance
biomes.description: Gears submerged in seawater; ropes move on their own.

biomes.name: Salt Chapel
biomes.description: A prayer hall beneath the tide, fossilized in white salt.

biomes.name: Molded Bunks
biomes.description: Dormitories fungus has learned to breathe inside.

biomes.name: Brass Inferno
biomes.description: Generators burn blood instead of whale oil.

biomes.name: Drowned Ossuary
biomes.description: Sailors’ skulls bob upward through a stagnant black sea.

biomes.name: The False Lens
biomes.description: A prison of mirrored light and impossible rooms.

biomes.name: The Black Tide
biomes.description: The ocean above becomes an upside-down sky of eyes.

biomes.name: The Buried Sun
biomes.description: The bottom of the world glows like the inside of a wound.

bosses.name: The Bellwright
bosses.lore: A brass keeper with an empty face and a stolen key.

bosses.name: The Bilge Mother
bosses.lore: A swollen engine pumping saltwater through its heart.

bosses.name: Saint of Brine
bosses.lore: A pulpit-lighthouse with drowned worshippers inside.

bosses.name: Mycelium Admiral
bosses.lore: A captain made from mycelial roots and parasitic anchors.

bosses.name: The Furnace Warden
bosses.lore: A nautical furnace demon fed by chain-driven boilers.

bosses.name: The Sunken Choir
bosses.lore: Many shipwrecked voices stuffed into a diving bell.

bosses.name: The Glass Matriarch
bosses.lore: The keeper’s reflection, made of razored lens fragments.

bosses.name: The Abyssal Leviathan
bosses.lore: A tentacled lighthouse creature crowned with the stolen beam.

bosses.name: The First Keeper
bosses.lore: Your predecessor, bound to the light that keeps Hell shut.
